description:
A property-based test, with a contract-valid generator, asserts the managed-document splice round-trip through the public `render_managed_document`.

## Background

The managed-document splice path in the repository-materialization subsystem (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/managed_document.rs`) has no property-based coverage; its round-trip guarantee is narrated rather than enforced.

The generator produces N region claims with unique, machine-distinct delimiters and content and outside bytes drawn from a delimiter-free alphabet, so `validate_regions` accepts them, interleaved into a base document per placement mode. The oracle goes through the public `render_managed_document` only and asserts the three round-trip properties: rendering is idempotent, each region's payload appears verbatim inside its region, and bytes outside all regions are unchanged.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A `proptest` generator produces only region claims that satisfy `validate_regions` (unique machine-distinct delimiters; content and outside bytes from a delimiter-free alphabet).
- [hard] REQ-02: A property test asserts, through the public `render_managed_document`, that rendering is idempotent, each region's payload appears verbatim within its region, and bytes outside all regions are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every assertion is a semantic property or relationship rather than a copied literal or field inventory.

## Notes

Assert observable semantic properties per the project's semantic-test-assertions invariant. The test lives in an in-crate test module and adds no integration-test target.
title: Managed-document splice round-trip property test
